title: Speakers wanted for QGIS Open Day + secret revealed
content:
This month's QGIS Open Day is coming up. Have a project or use case to share? Email: opendays@qgis.org 

Too shy to present, or seen a cool QGIS use elsewhere? Here's a secret: we're launching QGIS in the Wild, a new initiative to collect use cases and show the world what QGIS can do.

To contribute, email administration@qgis.org. Subject: "QGIS in the wild". Body: organization name, what they did, + links/screenshots. Bonus points if you have a contact willing to share more.  

Happy mapping
